why: RJ-X76, pending BK-8 (suiteui/brush-keys): Photo's catalog has the brush keys' commands but no stroke by command yet, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. Picks the Brush, steps its size up twice from 20 px, sets its opacity to 50%, paints a black horizontal stroke from (20, 50) to (180, 50) across a white 200 x 100 image and exports the PNG. The trap: a step lands on another tool's settings, or the opacity digit goes to the layer instead of the brush. The assertion: the stroke's vertical extent is 30 px within 1, and its centre pixel is 50% grey within 3 levels. The turn-on sets platforms to linux and macos once BK-8's stroke command lands.
